name: HPCCG on Tenstorrent (Daisytuner)
description: Daisytuner's case study porting the HPCCG conjugate-gradient mini-app to Wormhole and Blackhole: the SPMV, WAXPBY and DDOT kernels run on Tensix cores over an ELLPACK matrix layout, with the Daisytuner Optimizing Compiler Collection (DOCC) handling parallelisation and offload.
author: Daisytuner
